origin: the dispose check on a staged Decision had no auto-lane coverage: a synthesizer can dress a technical fork as a Decision — stakes present, content sub-bar — and the session's own re-derivation must settle it rather than stop. This walks the analysis loop to that moment: a plain proposal takes the auto opt-in, then the staged naming Decision is re-derived against the bar, found technical, settled in the staging file with its derivation, and rendered plain under --gate auto — auto-approved, no decision menu, no user turn
answers: a — approve this proposal and take the rest automatically
